blueprint.name: BNK on kind (create cluster)
blueprint.description: Provision a kind cluster from scratch and install BNK on it: cluster create, DPU node labels, cert-manager + BNK CA chain, F5 Lifecycle Operator, CNEInstance, BNK License. For developer / POC environments.

outcomes: kind cluster created on the local Docker daemon (or a remote host via DOCKER_HOST)
Two worker nodes labeled for TMM scheduling (DPU emulation)
cert-manager installed plus the BNK CA ClusterIssuer chain
F5 Lifecycle Operator (FLO) installed with FAR pull secret + JWT license

prerequisites.name: far_auth_key
prerequisites.description: Run `tar zxOf ~/far/f5-far-auth-key.tgz` on a host that has the tarball, then paste the output here. Do NOT import the raw .tgz file — bnk-forge expects the extracted text content (a base64-encoded JSON service account key). Stored encrypted; never serialized into terraform.tfvars.json or task output.

prerequisites.name: jwt_token
prerequisites.description: F5 BNK subscription JWT. Stored encrypted; never serialized into terraform.tfvars.json or task output.

The bnk-forge worker container needs access to a Docker daemon — either /var/run/docker.sock mounted from the host, or DOCKER_HOST pointing at a reachable remote daemon. The compose override that mounts docker.sock into the worker is described in this repo's README.

prerequisites.name: bare_metal_ssh
prerequisites.description: Optional. Bare-metal credential template with ssh_user + ssh_host populated lets the blueprint deploy kind to a remote host via DOCKER_HOST=ssh://user@host. Leave empty to use the local Docker socket.

input_summary.label: Input guidance
input_summary.value: For a local kind cluster, just pick a cluster_name (default 'bnk') and ensure both project secrets are populated. For a remote kind cluster, attach a bare-metal credential template with SSH details.

optional.name: cluster_name
optional.description: Name of the kind cluster to create.

optional.name: ssh_user
optional.description: Optional SSH user from a bare-metal credential template; combined with ssh_host into DOCKER_HOST=ssh://user@host.

optional.name: ssh_host
optional.description: Optional SSH host from a bare-metal credential template.

optional.name: docker_host
optional.description: Explicit DOCKER_HOST override (e.g. tcp://host:2375). Takes precedence over ssh_user/ssh_host. Empty = use the local Docker socket.

optional.name: kind_node_image
optional.description: Optional kind node image override. Empty = provider default.

modules.name: kind cluster create
modules.description: Create a kind cluster (1 cp + 4 workers, dual-stack, default CNI off) and emit BNK registration outputs.

modules.name: Label DPU worker nodes
modules.description: Label two workers app=f5-tmm and taint them dpu=true:NoSchedule (DPU emulation for kind).

modules.name: cert-manager
modules.description: Install cert-manager + the BNK CA ClusterIssuer chain.

modules.name: F5 Lifecycle Operator
modules.description: Install FLO with FAR pull secret + JWT license.

modules.name: CNEInstance
modules.description: Apply the CNEInstance CR with kind-appropriate defaults.

modules.name: BNK License
modules.description: Apply the BNK License CR using the jwt_token project secret.
